package: M22 audit follow-up, Package 6 (amendments A2, A6; findings F7, F9)
statusRule: A gate is passed only with its own receipt. A gate that was not run is deferred, never passed.

gates.where: local, run-owned isolated stack (cached Postgres, Auth and PostgREST images, no published ports), all 77 migrations, the 160-item code catalogue through the operator import, a production build; no hosted action

realCsp.how: HTTPS API bridge on 127.0.0.1 with a run-only certificate trusted only by the test browser (SPKI pin) and the local Next server (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS)

steps.step: MFA sign-in, Owner, Author, Reviewer (real TOTP)
Two tabs: second save refused, work kept
Author creates a quiz in the module (version 1)
Reviewer reads it read-only with the answer key
Rebuild; anonymous visitor sees the change
Signed-in learner sees it; Mark complete saves progress
Owner withdraws; lesson leaves the live snapshot
Author archives; Owner restores, re-approves, makes live again
Server killed mid-save: written at most once, editor shows the uncertain outcome
Owner revokes the Author: next save refused (42501), editor closed

statedLimits: Withdraw is checked at the live snapshot; no second rebuild after withdrawal
Make live, withdraw, archive, restore and revoke ran through each person's own signed-in session (the same store rules the pages call), not by clicking
findingsFixed: A real defect: the new-quiz page failed in production builds (server page called a client-module function). Fixed in 7fd1b83 with a guard test for the whole class
Harness defects only (no app change): byte decoding of large responses, label-based locators for filled fields, the stepped lesson's completion control, the snapshot reply shape

gates.proof: Regenerates all 11 files of the hosted-accepted Package 4 packet byte for byte, and passes its 28-case rehearsal with the runner's stage generator
